svg.aria-label: Example /learn session: the tutor explains osmosis with a citation, gives a micro-task, grades a wrong answer, logs the mistake and gives a simpler step
svg.text: Osmosis is the passive movement of water across a selectively permeable
membrane — towards the side with the higher solute concentration.
Micro-task (2 min): a red blood cell is placed in a hypertonic solution.
Does water move in or out, and what happens to the cell?
❌ Not quite: hypertonic = more solute outside, so water moves OUT
→ logged to mistakes.md · re-tested later this session and at the next /review
Simpler step: which side has more solute — inside the cell, or outside?
